note: Roadmap and 100% Completion checklist figures as reported by KeenGamer and gamemapa (via PowerPyx), cross-checked against Push Square. The in-game checklist under Progress > Stats is the authority — use these numbers to plan, the game to confirm.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

stages.summary: Play the story in order, enjoy it, and do the one missable thing while you still can. Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals through your binoculars from the start — the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles and 100 animals, and collecting them naturally saves hours later. Start side questlines as their icons appear (Kenton from Chapter 1, Billy from Chapter 2, Andy, Randy and Tyrone from Chapter 3). Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so separate saves are your only backup. Never turn cheats on — they disable trophies and saving.
stages.title: Story and side activities
stages.trophies: 12 story trophies + Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm, Master of None, Baited My Tackle, Stick Fiddler

stages.summary: After the final mission, Progress > Stats gains the 100% Completion checklist. Work it top to bottom. You do not need everything — most lines ask for a portion — but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone time trials and Bret's Target Decks are all required in full. Do the robbery totals first (they also fund the garages), then collectibles, then races and challenges. A Long Road pops when the checklist hits 100%.
stages.title: Reach 100% completion
stages.trophies: A Long Road, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, Earn Cash, Not Kudos, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, One Last Thing, Whip It Good, The Goodtime State, Pest Control, Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play, Dime on the Dollar, Treat Yo Self, Little Boxes, On the Spot, Actions Speak Louder

stages.summary: The checklist does not ask for these, so they are usually what is left: finish the five named character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), complete eight Strangers & Freaks strands, hunt Bret's unique animal, and clear the remaining meditation spots. Then sweep the leftover combat, driving and robbery trophies.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
stages.trophies: Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Strangers & Freaks, Fair Game, Positive Mental Attitude, Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Gunslinger, Catch Me if You Can, Sneakthief, Let's Go Bowling

stages.summary: Seven trophies have no verified method yet (Challenging Tank, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Personal Best, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin). Do not burn hours on guesses: check back with the guides until two of them agree, then finish them. When the last one pops, Vice Got a Price! follows on its own.
stages.title: Unsolved trophies, then the platinum
stages.trophies: Challenging Tank, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Personal Best, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin, Vice Got a Price!
